name: tests-75pct-go-github-lossless-json-field-presence-and-4151
instr:
go-github cannot preserve each successfully decoded JSON object's original shape. Add an opt-in, lossless view distinguishing omitted, null, and populated properties without disturbing normalized model values. Observations and retained extensions must be value-owned, survive ordinary copies, and work with direct decoding and Client.Do.

Use lexically ordered, RFC 6901-escaped paths preserving nested object and array locations. Keep raw Event payload bytes opaque. Publish independent snapshots only after scalar coercion and polymorphic discrimination succeed. Failed decoding publishes neither presence nor extensions while preserving existing errors and response availability.

PublicKey, RulesetReviewer, other Ruleset identifiers, flexible scalar-or-array models, ProjectV2Item, and CopilotSeatDetails must retain accepted representations, normalization, and discriminator behavior. Lossless encoding recursively retains unknown non-null properties, while known model values and exceptional Timestamp and TreeEntry encodings remain authoritative. Duplicate known or unknown properties produce deterministic escaped-path diagnostics, retain normal decoding's final value, and encode one authoritative property. Default JSON encoding and existing String and Stringify output remain unchanged.

JSONPresence exposes State, Paths, and Duplicates; JSONPresenceReporter exposes JSONPresence(). PresenceOf, UnknownJSONFields, DecodeJSONWithPresence, and MarshalJSONPreservingUnknown provide discover
